Functional principal components of velocity curves

Source: R/curve-velocity.R
wgh_fpca_curves.Rd

A threshold-free description of curve shape, the robustness analysis of the spurt duration study (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.09.26362696): functional PCA of the children's velocity curves on a common grid using fdapace. The second component usually captures spurt width.

Usage

wgh_fpca_curves(panel, max_k = 4)

Arguments

panel

Output of wgh_velocity_panel().

max_k

Maximum number of components.

Value

A list with the fdapace fit, a tibble of scores per child and the variance explained.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("fdapace", quietly = TRUE)) {
  boys <- growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$sex == "Male", ]
  boys <- boys[boys$pid %in% unique(boys$pid)[1:300], ]
  fit <- wgh_fit_sitar(boys, df = 4, age_range = c(6, 18))
  pan <- wgh_velocity_panel(fit, time = "aphv", grid = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.1), observed_only = FALSE)
  fp <- wgh_fpca_curves(pan[pan$id %in% unique(pan$id)[1:150], ])
  fp$variance_explained
}
#> [1] 0.8964266 0.9997677 0.9999531 1.0000000
# }
